description: Natural-language job search, e.g. 'remote senior Rust jobs in Europe'. Understands salary floors ('over €120k') and exclusions ('no crypto'). Returns ids, titles and URLs, the total, filters: how the query was read (as search_jobs arguments), and broadened: filters it dropped to find any results. Use fetch for details. Prefer search_jobs when you can set filters directly.
name: search
title: Search (natural language)
